risk_description: A screening result is presented as validated movable cash
early_warning_indicator: Deck or business case calls $38.13m surplus available or movable
mitigation: Keep $0 established mobility; label 7/14-day outputs as screening results; require account certification buffer and economics
contingency: Shift Wave 1 value to visibility and validation

risk_description: Estimated manual capacity is converted directly into P&L or headcount
early_warning_indicator: 150 hours/month appears as savings without observed time/removal rate
mitigation: Separate capacity from P&L; time sample; preserve/replace controls
contingency: Exclude labor benefit from funded base

risk_description: External cases or products predetermine the ACG solution
early_warning_indicator: Option language mirrors a published solution rather than ACG evidence
mitigation: Score three genuine ACG options; use public cases only as context

risk_description: Local legal tax settlement or service constraints emerge after design
mitigation: Build account-level constraint matrix with local sign-off
contingency: Defer pooling or closure in affected markets

risk_description: Centralization concentrates access resilience or operational failure
early_warning_indicator: No SoD emergency-payment BCP cyber or rollback design
mitigation: Require control inventory failure tests local emergency rights and rollback
contingency: Use federated interim model and pause scale

risk_description: Pilot disrupts critical payments or peak-season service
early_warning_indicator: Pilot overlaps peak or lacks SLA/rollback
mitigation: Select bounded cohorts outside peak; four compliant weeks; four-hour rollback

risk_description: Three-ERP complexity and retiring legacy platform create rework
early_warning_indicator: Design assumes uniform integration or invests deeply in retiring ERP
mitigation: Use staged interfaces and retirement-aware architecture
contingency: Use controlled interim files and defer deep integration

risk_description: Six-month period or payment extract omits material cash-demand patterns
early_warning_indicator: Payroll tax seasonal/peak receipts settlement-calendar or extraordinary needs are not fully captured
mitigation: Request longer history and forecast events; separately validate complete cash needs; retain complete-window sensitivities
contingency: Label period limit and keep screening result outside funded value

risk_description: Actual fees rates transfer costs and implementation costs remain unavailable
early_warning_indicator: Business case uses supplied estimates without owner sign-off
mitigation: Obtain invoices facility data transfer economics cost and timing ranges
contingency: Present validation case rather than committed benefit

risk_description: Public source claims become stale or overstated
early_warning_indicator: Live source differs from logged claim
mitigation: Retain access date method limitation and reverify before final

early_warning_indicator: Report introduces revenue ratios without perimeter note
mitigation: Reconcile period perimeter eliminations and rounding

risk_description: Receivables or FX conclusions are inferred without subject data
early_warning_indicator: Recommendation quantifies AR or FX performance from proxy data
mitigation: Keep P1/data-gated; request controlled subject extracts

risk_description: Payment rates are generalized or overlapping cohorts are double-counted
early_warning_indicator: Narrative drops the 7,600-record qualifier or adds manual-touch and cross-border-wire totals
mitigation: Use four mutually exclusive strata and a deduplicated union; reconcile source totals and sampling
contingency: Limit wording and exclude enterprise benefit

risk_description: Payment and process repair baselines are blended despite 84% mismatch
mitigation: Keep separate labeled sources and reconciliation gate
contingency: Use 50-hour stress only; exclude funded base

risk_description: Connectivity pilot improves date reporting but not decision usefulness
early_warning_indicator: Same-day rate improves without certified cutoff balance type or reconciliation
mitigation: Define timestamp balance and decision-consequence KPI before pilot
contingency: Stop scale and redesign data contract

risk_description: Provisional maturity scores are treated as an external benchmark or composite rating
early_warning_indicator: Scores are averaged or used as vendor-selection proof
mitigation: Keep observable criteria confidence and no overall average
contingency: Remove scores and use evidence statements only
